newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of a women's World Cup super-G on Saturday:
Previous World Cup wins: 3 downhills - Garmisch 1994, Cortina 1996, Cortina 1997

Other facts: Double Olympic bronze medallist in 1994 and reigning super-G world champion. Her first win at Garmisch was overshadowed by tragedy when Austria's Ulrike Maier died in a crash on the course. Her father is a traditional woodcarver in Val Gardena and Kostner sometimes helps him to paint the statues he makes. Has now won three of her four victories in Cortina.
